description: Client-side script for the 'Water Analysis' doctype in ERPNext, handling form events such as load, refresh, and laboratory testing date updates.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Handles the form load event, loads contents if water_analysis_criteria is undefined.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles the form refresh event, hides map tools in the interface.

methods.name: laboratory_testing_datetime
methods.description: Updates the lab result date when laboratory testing datetime is changed.
